title: Insurance Claim Repairs Payment Terms — Deductible Timing, Methods, Financing and Refund Time
content:
These terms govern how the customer's balance on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is paid, by repair class.

| Repair class | Deductible paid | Accepted payment methods | Financing through the network's partner | Smallest balance that may be financed | Overpayment returned to the original method within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check | Not available | USD 0.00 (not applicable) | 5 |
| Standard Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Available | USD 300.00 | 5 |
| Major Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Available | USD 300.00 | 5 |
| Structural Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Available | USD 300.00 | 5 |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Available | USD 300.00 | 5 |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | at delivery, before release | card, ACH, cash, check, financing | Available | USD 300.00 | 5 |

1. **Deductible timing.** The deductible must be paid at delivery, before release, in every class.
2. **Payment methods.** The listed methods are those accepted for the customer balance; financing appears as a method only in the classes where it is available.
3. **Financing.** Where available, the customer balance may be paid through the network's third-party financing partner; the minimum is the smallest customer balance that may be financed. A minimum of USD 0.00 means the minimum does not apply.
4. **Refund time.** An overpayment is returned to the original payment method within the stated number of business days.

**Hypothetical balances.** In Standard Claim Repair a balance of USD 300.00 meets the financing minimum and a balance of USD 299.99 does not; in Express Claim Repair financing is not available at any balance.
